drug_class: Parenteral Nutrition / Intravenous Amino Acid Solution
purpose: This medicine delivers essential building blocks of protein directly into your bloodstream through an IV line. It is used when you cannot eat enough food or absorb nutrition normally — for example, after surgery, during serious illness, or if your digestive system is not working well. It helps your body heal, maintain muscle, and stay strong when regular eating is not possible.
how_it_works: Proteins in your body are made up of smaller pieces called amino acids. This solution contains a concentrated mix of those amino acids and goes straight into your vein, bypassing the digestive system entirely. Your body then uses these amino acids to build and repair tissues, support your immune system, and keep your organs working properly.
common_side_effects: Some people may experience nausea, mild fever, or flushing. You might notice redness, swelling, or irritation at the IV site. Changes in blood sugar levels, increased urination, or feeling warm are also possible. Your care team will watch for these closely.
warnings: Tell your doctor if you have kidney disease, liver problems, or any metabolic disorders, as this medicine must be used very carefully in those conditions. Blood tests will be done regularly to make sure your body is handling the nutrition safely. Never adjust the IV drip rate on your own. Allergic reactions, though rare, can happen — let your nurse know immediately if you feel short of breath, develop a rash, or feel unwell during the infusion.
typical_dosing: The dose is carefully calculated by your doctor or pharmacist based on your body weight, medical condition, and nutritional needs. It is given slowly through an IV, usually over many hours each day. Your care team will adjust the rate and amount based on regular blood test results to make sure you are getting exactly what your body needs.
